summary: Frontend Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience designing, building, and maintaining high-performance web and mobile user interfaces. Skilled in constructing reusable UI design systems and exploring modern micro-frontend architectures (Single-Spa, SystemJS) to scale platform experiences. Proven success integrating AI-powered workflows (Claude, Cursor) to speed up delivery cycles by 30% while writing secure, modular, and testable code.
